svg.title: 74HC595 Eight LED Outputs
svg.desc: A breadboard wiring view of 74HC595 Eight LED Outputs, on a half-size board of 30 columns with rows a–e above the central trough and f–j below it, and continuous power rails top and bottom. 4 parts are placed at their own tie points: uno (mcu uno), ic1 (dip pins=16), r1 (resistor 220), led1 (led red). 8 jumper wires run as smooth arcs in their net colours, each landing exactly on a hole. Off-board modules are drawn as labelled blocks with the pins they actually use on the edge facing the board.

text.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 74HC595 LED expander: Arduino drives serial data, clock and latch; each output feeds an LED through a resistor
